title: gomphandra penangiana var. ovalifolia
intro: Gomphandra penangiana var. ovalifolia, commonly known as the 'Malaysian Gomphandra', is a plant species belonging to the family Stemonuraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of the Malaysian Gomphandra are attributed to its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
